sentences.en: Personally, I think that corporal punishment is a necessary evil.
sentences.zh: 我个人认为体罚是必要的恶。

sentences.en: The trend of public opinion is against corporal punishment.
sentences.zh: 公众舆论的趋势是反对体罚。

sentences.en: I remember when corporal punishment was allowed in schools.
sentences.zh: 我记得当学校允许体罚的时候。
